lines.rom: ganapati ki seva mamgala meva seva se saba vighna taraim tina loka ke sakala devata dvara khare nita arja karaim
riddhi siddhi daksina vama virajem aru ananda som camara karaim dhupa dipa aru lie arati bhakta khare jayakara karaim
gura ke modaka bhoga lagata haim musaka vahana cadhya saraim saumya rupa ko dekha ganapati ke vighna bhaga ja dura paraim
bhado masa aru sukla caturthi dina dopara dura paraim liyo janma ganapati prabhu ji durga mana ananda bharaim
adbhuta baja baja indra ka deva bamdhu saba gana karaim sri samkara ke ananda upajya nama sunyo saba vighna taraim
ani vidhata baithe asana indra apsara nrtya karaim dekha veda brahma ji jako vighna vinasaka nama dharaim

ekadanta gajavadana vinayaka trinayana rupa anupa dharaim pagathambha sa udara pusta hai deva candrama hasya karaim
de sarapa sri candradeva ko kalahina tatkala karaim caudaha loka mem phirem ganapati tina loka mem rajya karaim
uthi prabhata japa karaim dhyana koi take karaja sarva saraim puja kala arati gavaim take sira yasa chatra phiraim
ganapati ki puja pahale karane se kama sabhi nirvighna saraim sabhi bhakta ganapati ji ke hatha jorakara stuti karaim
